source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.group: Foetid Bloat-Drone with Heavy Blight Launcher
data.summary: In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), when the Bloat-Drone’s attack kills an enemy model, roll a D6 before lifting that model. Add 1 if its unit is already Afflicted. On 5+, Afflict every enemy unit no farther than 6″ from the **destroyed** model until your next turn begins.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 6 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

trigger.event: owner attack destroys enemy model, before removing that model

effect.duration: until start of next own turn
